speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk

speaker: Josh Spector

You know, we called out last quarter earnings.

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk

speaker: Scott A. Richardson

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk
title: Retired at Celanese Corporation

speaker: Michael Leithead

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk

speaker: Michael Leithead
title: Analyst at Barclays

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk

So, you know, that's really paid off. We would have seen more of a hit this past quarter if we hadn't done that.

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk
title: Retired at Celanese Corporation
msg: I would say on the other products, not as much pricing pressure as margin pressure as we've seen some increase in raw materials, especially think about, POM, where we've seen some increase in ethylene. speaker: Michael Sison
title: Analyst at Wells Fargo

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk
title: Retired at Celanese Corporation

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk
title: Retired at Celanese Corporation

speaker: Ghansham Panjabi
title: Analyst at Baird

speaker: Lori J. Ryerkerk
